verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a payments SaaS like Kushki, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency for merchant or customer data. The country-specific docs paths (e.g., /cl, /mx) cover market-specific payment integrations, not data-storage location controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
